title: HueDeck native plugin manifest (v2)
description: manifest.json placed next to a native-v2 plugin's entry module. SignalRGB-compatible plugins (compat-v1 profile) have no manifest: their metadata comes from the module exports. A manifest lets HueDeck know which hardware the plugin may touch and which host capabilities it needs BEFORE loading any code; the host grants only the listed permissions and only hands the plugin handles matching its devices[] entries. Unlisted permissions are refused with a typed error at call time.

id.description: Stable plugin id: lowercase slug or reverse-DNS, e.g. "msi-mystic-light-7c91" or "dev.huedeck.msi-mystic-light". Used as the persistence/namespace key.

license.description: SPDX license expression, e.g. "MIT", "GPL-3.0-or-later" or "(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND CC0-1.0" (parentheses allowed; balance is checked by the loader). First-party plugins use GPL-3.0-or-later; third-party plugins may use any license (LICENSE-EXCEPTION.md).

documentation.description: Link shown in the device page (compat Documentation export).

entry.description: Path of the ES-module entry file, relative to the manifest directory; no leading slash, no .. segments.

compat.description: Declares that the entry module is written against the SignalRGB 2.5-era host surface (compat-v1 exports/lifecycle) and should be loaded through the compatibility profile with manifest-enforced permissions. Omit for a pure native-v2 module.

devices.description: Hardware the plugin may be bound to. Each entry is exactly one of: a USB vendor with product ids, an SMBus claim, or a network claim.

permissions.description: Host capabilities the plugin needs. Everything not listed is unavailable.

conflictingProcesses.description: Executable names that will fight over the device; reported to the user (never killed).

icon.description: Relative path or URL of a PNG/JPG/SVG image.

usbId.description: 16-bit USB id as a number or a hex string ("0x1462" / "1462").

usagePage.description: Usage page of the HID top-level collection.

usage.description: Usage of the HID top-level collection.

hidUsage.description: A generic driver for a standard HID collection on any device (e.g. 0x59/0x01, HID LampArray), used for devices no plugin claims by vendor and product id (HidUsages() export).

pids.description: USB product ids handled by this plugin.

transport.description: How the device is opened (compat Type export, lower-cased).

interfaces.description: Optional static endpoint filter (USB interface numbers; -1 = unknown/no MI_xx) applied before Validate().

tested.description: Product ids, from pids, that someone has run the plugin on with the real device; the others are untested.

addresses.description: 7-bit addresses the plugin may probe/drive (its SmbusAddresses()); the host refuses all others. The SPD EEPROM (0x50-0x57) is write-denied on every bus; on DIMM buses also 0x30-0x37, 0x48-0x4F and 0x50-0x5F. The I/O broker writes only to its own allowlist of first-party chipset addresses.

buses.description: Bus families Scan(bus) will be offered.

pci.description: GPU plugins: the cards (PCI vendor, device, subsystem vendor, subsystem device) whose bus Scan(bus) is offered (the plugin's BrandGPUList()).

tested.description: Cards, from pci, that someone has run the plugin on (GPU plugins); empty until then. RAM plugins list no pci and keep this empty until a run is recorded in their docs/hardware note.

deniedRegisters.description: Registers the host never lets the plugin write, at any address (save to flash/EEPROM and the like): its SmbusDeniedRegisters().

mdns.description: mDNS service types to browse, e.g. "_hap._tcp".

udpPorts.description: UDP ports the plugin may bind/broadcast on (opened only while the service runs).

hosts.description: Host/CIDR allowlist for outbound connections; empty = LAN only.

permission.description: hid: open matched HID collections; rawusb: bulk/control transfers; serial: COM port; smbus: chipset SMBus via broker; gpu-i2c: GPU I2C via NvAPI/ADLX; network-udp/tcp/http: @SignalRGB/udp, tcp and XMLHttpRequest; mdns: discovery browsing; dtls: DTLS-PSK sockets; lcd: frame grabs for LCD faces; fan-control: fan/temperature API; sensors: read system sensors; battery: battery feature; input-inject: keyboard/mouse sendHid (SendInput); input-events: emit key/mouse events into the macro bus; notifications: notify/addMessage; system-info: @SignalRGB/systeminfo and appInfo; settings: per-plugin persisted settings.
